Triage: promoted to `pm:queue`, type Task-shaped (traceability only, zero behaviour change). **Auto-adjudicated (triage seat): option 2 — land the attributive form now** for the 9 assertive sites, matching what `fieldRules.ts` (objectui#3828/PR #3887) and ADR-0036 (objectui#3888) already do in this repo. Rationale: safe under either outcome of objectstack#9628 (whose D13 timing is maintainer-merge-bound and therefore unbounded); inherits the ruling family already applied on the framework side by objectstack#9255's implementation.

Dispatch constraints:
- ⚠️ **`appAccessProbe.test.ts:25` is a correct citation** (nav/app capability gate — the one family D10 really decides) and must be left untouched; the sweep is the other 8 assertive sites.
- `docs/adr/0036-*` and `fieldRules.ts` are already attributive — do not re-edit. The 10 CHANGELOG entries decay untouched (historical record).
- Follow-up is pre-registered: once objectstack#9628's D13 exists on the framework side, a mechanical retarget of these sites to the resolvable anchor becomes a separate small card — filed by whichever seat accepts that PR, per the cross-repo follow-up rule.

Four prisms in one line each: coherence — stops asserting an anchor that does not resolve; pull — traceability for every future reader of 8 live sites; error-resistance — the next citer copies the careful form instead of the plain inheritance; scope — prose-only, no new surface. Veto window open; listed in the round's adjudication section.

**PM correction — my dispatch brief's site count was wrong, and so is this card's. Measured on `origin/main`.**

I dispatched this as "sweep 8 of 9 assertive sites, `appAccessProbe.test.ts:25` fenced out as correct". Both halves of that are off. Excluding CHANGELOGs (archive, untouched), a `\bD10\b` sweep of tracked files finds **10** citation sites, of which **3 are already correct** — so the sweep set is **7**.

### The root fact, which none of the sites states

**objectui's own `docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` contains no D10 at all.** It is about console AI chat docking. In *this* repo the bare string "ADR-0057 D10" resolves to a document that says nothing of the kind. The defect is the **missing framework qualifier**, not the substantive claim — *"server enforces, client is courtesy"* is correct and must survive any edit unchanged.

### Already correct — ⛔ do NOT sweep

| site | why it is correct |
|---|---|
| `packages/data-objectstack/src/appAccessProbe.test.ts:25` | a **verbatim quotation** of the objectstack#8013 ruling, where framework numbering is the ambient context |
| **`packages/core/src/evaluator/fieldRules.ts:38`** | **already fully disambiguated — my brief wrongly counted this as assertive.** It reads: *"the framework's ADR-0057 D10 — server enforces, client is courtesy (framework numbering; this repo's own ADR-0057 is an unrelated document)"* |
| `docs/adr/0036-field-conditional-rules.md:91` | already disambiguated, and it is the **model wording** the other two derive from: *"**ADR-0057 D10** (that is the **framework's** ADR numbering; this repo's own ADR-0057, `0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md`, is an unrelated document)"* |

⛔ `docs/adr/**` is additionally a **governed surface** — not to be touched by this card at all.

### The actual sweep set — seven

1. `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1059`
2. `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx:88`
3. `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:426`
4. `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts:16`
5. `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.test.tsx:19`
6. `packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRecordCrudVerdicts.ts:44`
7. `packages/react/src/hooks/useCapabilityGate.ts:27`

### Clause ② is not tripped and no ruling is needed

The corrected wording is **derived from an authority** — two of them, already shipping in this repo (ADR-0036:91 and `fieldRules.ts:38`). Derived from an authority → repair. Hand-typed with nothing to derive from → a new contract decision. This is the first, so the implementing agent should follow the existing wording rather than invent a third phrasing.

Sent to the implementing agent with the standing instruction that **if its own measurement disagrees with mine, it acts on its measurement and reports the disagreement** — a dispatch is a hypothesis, and this one was wrong twice.
